result.instructions: Tools for WakaTime, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many hours did I code last week, and in which projects?"; "Which programming languages did I use most this month?"; "What was my best coding day over the last 30 days?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WakaTime data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run wakatime_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wakatime_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wakatime_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. wakatime_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wakatime_get_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The WakaTime user this key belongs to: id, username, display name, email, timezone, plan, last plugin/project/branch and last heartbeat time. GET /users/current.

tools.name: wakatime_get_summaries
tools.title: Get daily summaries
tools.description: Coding activity as one summary per day for a date range: grand total plus breakdowns by project, language, editor, operating system, category, dependencies and machine, with cumulative total and daily average. Give start and end, or one named range. Use project (and branches) to also get per-branch and per-file entities. GET /users/current/summaries.

project.description: Only time logged to this project.

branches.description: Comma separated branch names; needs project.

timezone.description: IANA timezone such as Europe/Berlin (default: the user's timezone).

timeout.description: Keystroke timeout in minutes (default: the user's preference).

writes_only.description: Only count heartbeats that were file writes (default: the user's preference).

tools.name: wakatime_get_stats
tools.title: Get coding stats
tools.description: Aggregated coding stats for a range: total time, daily average, best day, AI vs human line changes, and the full breakdown by language, project, editor, operating system, category, dependencies and machine. If the reply says it is still calculating, call again shortly. GET /users/current/stats/{range}.

range.description: Time range: last_7_days, last_30_days, last_6_months, last_year, all_time, a year (2026) or a month (2026-09).

timeout.description: Keystroke timeout in minutes (default: the user's preference).

writes_only.description: Only count heartbeats that were file writes (default: the user's preference).

tools.name: wakatime_get_all_time_since_today
tools.title: Get all-time total
tools.description: Total coding time since the user's WakaTime account (or one project) was created, with daily average and the range covered. GET /users/current/all_time_since_today.

tools.name: wakatime_get_status_bar_today
tools.title: Get today's coding time
tools.description: Today's coding activity as shown in an editor status bar: grand total plus breakdowns by project, language, editor and more. Cached data only; an empty summary means the cache is still being filled. GET /users/current/status_bar/today.

tools.name: wakatime_get_insight
tools.title: Get insight
tools.description: One WakaTime insight for a range: stats, weekdays (average per weekday), days (per-day totals, optionally one weekday), ai_days, best_day, daily_average, or a breakdown by projects, languages, editors, categories, machines or operating_systems. GET /users/current/insights/{insight_type}/{range}.

range.description: Time range: last_7_days, last_30_days, last_6_months, last_year, all_time, a year (2026) or a month (2026-09).

weekday.description: Only for insight_type 'days': a weekday, 0-6 or monday..sunday.

timeout.description: Keystroke timeout in minutes (default: the user's preference).

writes_only.description: Only count heartbeats that were file writes (default: the user's preference).

tools.name: wakatime_get_durations
tools.title: Get durations for a day
tools.description: The coding sessions (durations) of one day, each with start time, length in seconds and the project (or other slice) it belongs to. Needs the read_heartbeats scope for OAuth tokens. GET /users/current/durations.

date.description: The day, yyyy-mm-dd, in the user's timezone.

branches.description: Comma separated branch names; needs project.

timezone.description: IANA timezone such as Europe/Berlin (default: the user's timezone).

slice_by.description: What to slice durations by (default project).

timeout.description: Keystroke timeout in minutes (default: the user's preference).

writes_only.description: Only count heartbeats that were file writes (default: the user's preference).

tools.name: wakatime_get_heartbeats
tools.title: Get heartbeats for a day
tools.description: The raw heartbeats (activity pings from editor plugins) of one day: entity (file path or domain), type, category, project, branch, language, time, lines and AI line changes. Large days are cut to `limit` heartbeats starting at `offset`; total_heartbeats says how many the day has. Needs the read_heartbeats scope for OAuth tokens. GET /users/current/heartbeats.

date.description: The day, yyyy-mm-dd, 12am to 11:59pm in the user's timezone.

limit.description: Return at most this many heartbeats (default 200).

offset.description: Skip this many heartbeats first (to read a busy day in slices; default 0).

tools.name: wakatime_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: The user's WakaTime projects with id, name, repository, color, clients, first and last heartbeat time and badge/public-url flags. Optionally filter by a name search. GET /users/current/projects.

q.description: Filter project names by this search term.

page.description: Page number, from 1. Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: wakatime_list_machines
tools.title: List machines
tools.description: The machines (computers) that sent coding activity: id, name, host name, IP, timezone and last-seen time. GET /users/current/machine_names.

tools.name: wakatime_list_user_agents
tools.title: List editors and plugins used
tools.description: The editor and plugin user agents that sent coding activity: editor, version, OS, AI model if any, and last-seen time. GET /users/current/user_agents.

tools.name: wakatime_list_commits
tools.title: List project commits
tools.description: Commits of a WakaTime project with the time spent coding on each (needs a connected repository). Filter by author or branch; paged. Needs the read_heartbeats scope for OAuth tokens. GET /users/current/projects/{project}/commits.

project.description: Project name exactly as WakaTime shows it (see wakatime_list_projects).

author.description: Only commits by this author (WakaTime username).

page.description: Page number, from 1. Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: wakatime_get_commit
tools.title: Get project commit
tools.description: One commit of a WakaTime project by hash, with the time spent coding on it. Needs the read_heartbeats scope for OAuth tokens. GET /users/current/projects/{project}/commits/{hash}.

project.description: Project name exactly as WakaTime shows it (see wakatime_list_projects).

tools.title: List goals
tools.description: The user's coding goals: title, type, target seconds, status, chart data per period, languages/projects/editors it covers and who it is shared with. Needs the read_goals scope for OAuth tokens. GET /users/current/goals.

page.description: Page number, from 1. Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: wakatime_get_goal
tools.title: Get goal
tools.description: One goal by id with its chart data (cached; an empty chart means the cache is still building, retry shortly). GET /users/current/goals/{goal}.

tools.name: wakatime_list_orgs
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: The WakaTime organizations the user belongs to: id, name, people count, keystroke timeout and timezone preferences and what the user may do. Needs the read_orgs scope for OAuth tokens. GET /users/current/orgs.

page.description: Page number, from 1. Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.title: List organization dashboards

tools.title: List dashboard members
tools.description: The members of an organization dashboard: id, username, full name, email, photo and whether their activity is view-only hidden. GET /users/current/orgs/{org}/dashboards/{dashboard}/members.

tools.description: The ranking of a private leaderboard: rank, member and total coding time (or AI lines / AI spend) per language, country and board type; paged (without page it starts at the user's own page). GET /users/current/leaderboards/{board}.

board_type.description: Ranking: time (hours coded, default), manual (excluding AI coding), ai (AI lines) or spend (AI spend).

is_hireable.description: Only coders with the hireable badge.

board_type.description: Ranking: time (hours coded, default), manual (excluding AI coding), ai (AI lines) or spend (AI spend).
